quote: The operator of a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter within a business or residence district entering into or emerging from an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway, driveway or building, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision.

activation.condition: Operator of a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter enters into or emerges from an alley, driveway or building in a business or residence district and approaches a sidewalk or continuing sidewalk area.

obligation.description: Stop immediately before driving onto the sidewalk or continuing sidewalk area, and yield to a pedestrian as necessary to avoid collision.

timing.description: Stop before sidewalk entry and yield at the pedestrian conflict; no statutory numeric duration or distance is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The law supplies no numeric stopping distance or dwell time; original boundary, body motion and temporal order need review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as may be necessary to avoid collision
judgment_calls_needed.note: Pedestrian position and crossing conflict require original sources and independent judgment; no time-to-conflict cutoff is supplied.
